## Career Page Watcher

**Objective:** Simulate monitoring company career pages for new job postings.

**Owner:** Team 2 - Hiring Intelligence

Runs once per day, generates mock job data for a fixed list of tracked companies (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, Adobe), and sends one signal per company to the same backend ingest webhook used by the Signal Ingestion Poller.

When real career-page scraping is added later, this is where the HTML Extract + diff-against-last-snapshot logic (SRS Workflow 2) will replace the mock generator - the rest of the pipeline (POST + error handling) stays the same.

nodes.name: POST to Signal Ingest Webhook
nodes.notes: Runs once per generated company item (5 requests per execution). Same endpoint as the Signal Ingestion Poller - the backend treats both sources identically, distinguished only by the `source` field.
